newsitem.title: FINLAND: Ericsson says GF788 sales beat forecast.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says GF788 sales beat forecast.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson CEO Lars Ramqvist said on Thursday sales of its small GF788 handset were beating expectations and deliveries were lagging orders, but the company said it expects to catch up in June-July.
"We have a better response from the market than we had expected, so we are a little bit behind in deliveries," Ramqvist told a news conference here.
Jan-Mikael Von Schantz, Ericsson manager in Finland, said deliveries would catch up in June-July.
Ramqvist said demand was particularly strong in "big markets and Asia."
He also said Ericsson was still seeing no price pressure on digital handsets: "There have been no price pressures ... as we are standing here," he told Reuters.
